channel.title: EVENTFAQS Media Pvt - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from EVENTFAQS Media Pvt (eventfaqs.com)

item.title: Shakira Returns to India for Feeding India Concert 2026 in Mumbai & Delhi
item.description: Shakira will headline the Feeding India Concert 2026 in Mumbai and Delhi, marking the initiative’s first multi-city edition aimed at advancing the Zero Hunger mission.

item.title: Karnataka Tourism Society Hosts CONNECT 2026 Stakeholder Meet in Bengaluru
item.description: The Karnataka Tourism Society, in partnership with the state government, hosted CONNECT 2026 in Bengaluru, outlining investment targets and reinforcing PPP-driven growth under the Tourism Policy 2024–29.

item.title: Rashi Entertainment Hosts ‘आनन्दम FEST 2026’ for Delhi Government in Greater Kailash
item.description: Rashi Entertainment will host आनन्दम FEST 2026 on behalf of the Delhi Government, bringing music, fitness and community celebrations to Greater Kailash on February 21–22.

item.title: JBC Kabaddi League to Launch in 2026 with Five Teams
item.description: The Kabaddi Associations of Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh have sanctioned the JBC Kabaddi League, set to debut in 2026 with five teams and Randhir Singh Sehrawat as Brand Ambassador.

item.title: Gateway of India Lights Up for India-France Year of Innovation 2026 with Public Video Mapping Show Until February 22
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Emmanuel Macron launched the India-France Year of Innovation 2026 at the Gateway of India, accompanied by a public video mapping show running through February 22.

item.title: JD Design Awards 2026 Theme Unveiled in Mumbai; 17 Cities to Participate
item.description: JD Institute of Fashion Technology has announced the JD Design Awards 2026, with its theme unveiling set for 24 February in Mumbai and multi-city showcases scheduled through September.

item.title: British High Commission Hosts AI Showcase in Delhi to Highlight UK-India Technology Partnership
item.description: The British High Commission hosted a major AI reception in Delhi, highlighting UK leadership in artificial intelligence and strengthening technology ties with India following the AI Impact Summit 2026.

item.title: Esports Federation of India Opens NESC 2026 Registrations to Select Squad for Asian Games
item.description: The Esports Federation of India has opened registrations for NESC 2026, the national qualifier that will determine India’s esports squad for the 2026 Asian Games in Japan.

item.title: Laqshya Media Group Executes India’s First Luxury Automotive Anamorphic Activation for Defender
item.description: Laqshya Media Group has executed India’s first luxury automotive anamorphic activation, delivering a large-scale 3D Defender showcase in Mumbai and other key cities.

item.title: NODWIN Gaming Announces Mumbai Comic Con 2026 for May 9–10
item.description: NODWIN Gaming has announced that Mumbai Comic Con 2026 will be held on May 9–10 at Jio World Convention Centre, bringing together fans, creators and pop culture communities for a two-day celebration.
